topics.title: FME Awards Chaos - Award Presentation
topics.summary: During the FME Awards ceremony, Howard Stern and Robin Quivers attempt to award Norman Lear a prize for ‘Most Embarrassing Interview’ involving chaotic interactions with guests like Mitch Fertile, John Melendez (who stutters), and Melissa Gilbert. The effort culminates in awarding an unknown recipient while discussing Rob Lowe's recent marriage.

topics.title: Sublet Award & Radio Director Departure
topics.summary: During a radio show segment, Howard discusses his competition with China Phillips and her breakup. He awkwardly accepts an award for Melissa Gilbert’s Albany subletter, Ed Levine, leading to a chaotic conversation about Andy Bloom's departure as program director and the value of sleeping in Rob Lowe’s bed.

topics.title: Houston Job Offer & Listener Award
topics.summary: During a radio segment, a caller offers an all-night Houston job and negotiates compensation. The hosts then introduce a listener vote for ‘sexiest guest,’ awarding Abby Hoffman due to his incoherent performance, referencing past controversies involving Willie B.

topics.title: Radio Host Chaos & Award Night
topics.summary: The broadcast features a chaotic discussion surrounding sports figures, including Leonard Marshall’s commentary at the Super Bowl and Charles Barkley's interactions with Donald Trump. A publicist discusses Whoopi Goldberg’s awards, followed by an outlandish anecdote about a cab driver holding up legs during a football game.

topics.title: Donald Trump and Radio Host Discussions
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, hosts discuss preparations for Donald Trump’s presence, referencing decorating efforts. Calls are made regarding concert tickets and an alleged spitting incident involving Rocky Cleaver with conflicting accounts of what occurred; the hosts also debate Leonard Marshall's musical achievements and express skepticism about sports figures as role models.

topics.title: Stern Show Vegas World & Book Launch
topics.summary: During a chaotic radio segment, Howard Stern discusses his failed Vegas World game show concept with celebrity guests including Dean Martin and Sidney Sheldon. He details the bizarre attractions of the hotel, interviews various personalities (including Jessica Hahn), reveals plans for upcoming books about jokes and an autobiography detailing his life.
